categories_thin: Electrical contractors: still no walk-in electrical business with a commercial Highland Park address. Searches returned only a sole proprietor at a residential address (not recorded, per the no-home-address rule).

General contracting, roofing, painting and paving: Highland Park is a built-out residential borough; the roofers that market to it (e.g. American Contracting Team, whose own contact page gives a 07726 base) sit outside the zone. Only Eleven Exterior has an in-borough address. A handful of small GCs surfaced only in the bulk directory, which is why they carry low-confidence evidence flags.

Manufacturing and wholesale: after Birnn Chocolates was dropped (the 314 Cleveland Ave building is advertised for sale and no page confirms it still operates) the industrial pocket yields only Corriguard Packaging, Ultra Chem and the two labs at 810 N 2nd Ave. No working manufacturer with a current own-site presence surfaced.

Group A and B are out of scope for this CD zone and were not swept: law, accounting, insurance, real estate, engineering/surveying, staffing (A) and doctors, dentists, therapists, chiropractors, optometrists, veterinarians, salons, barbers, nail/beauty, fitness and martial arts (B). Concretely, the njtgo page lists Careza Pharmacy, Unite Pharmacy, The Park MedSpa, Prime Health & Wellness (PT), Park Dental, Zen Dental, Dr. Sherman OD, iBrows, BLOOM Custom Hair Color, The Loft Salon, Salon Envy, Slick Barbershop, Best Barbershop, Highland Park Tattoo, Studio @ 808 Health Club and Kinetics Personal Training - all group A/B, deliberately not carried over. Pharmacies and Highland Park Wine & Liquors are excluded types regardless of group.

No hotel/motel, self-storage facility, dedicated appliance-only store or music-instrument retail store exists inside the borough as far as these sources show; the only national-chain outlets found (U-Haul at 101 Raritan, LUKOIL at 702 Raritan) were excluded as chains.
caveats: Franchises were removed uniformly: Arthur Murray Highland Park, Kumon of Highland Park and Minuteman Press of Highland Park are all franchise-branded and are no longer listed. No exemption was recorded for any of them.

Five duplicate storefront pairs were merged: Arch Auto Service Shop (was Kam Soon / ArchAuto), Jaqui-Kuhn with All Faiths Cremation, Durable Parts with Liquid Gold Enterprise, Wonderland Flora with Highland Flower, and Spin and Grin with Wayne Wash World III. Each merged row names both trading names in its notes.

Removed as defunct, wrong-business or unverifiable: Jack's Hardware & Plumbing (storefront long since reused), Highland Park Bowling (hpbowling.com is an Illinois bowling centre), White Lotus Home (Highland Park site is a former showroom; current NJ showroom is in New Brunswick), Highland Bark (listing marks it closed) and The Art of Relevé Dance Company (theartofreleve.org returns HTTP 404 and no loadable substitute page was found).

Also dropped: Birnn Chocolates (confectionery production, and the Cleveland Ave building is advertised for sale) and Pino's Gift Basket Shoppe (food gift baskets attached to an excluded liquor business).

Several rows come only from a bulk aggregator (us-business.info) that mixes stale rows, duplicate names and mislabelled categories; those are marked 'one directory only (bulk aggregator, unconfirmed)' and must be verified before outreach.

Yellow Pages, Superpages, Cylex, Localsolution, ChamberofCommerce, D&B, Pawlicy and Bizapedia all return 403/429 to automated access, so a number of their listings are known only from the entry text captured in other directories.
Google Maps in this browser returned only a 5-result 'limited view' per query, so Maps was supplemental rather than a completeness base.
Main Street Highland Park's official business directory page was last seen stating it is being updated with no listings, so the borough's own merchant list could not be used.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API and Nominatim could not be reached (timeouts), so no OSM sweep was possible.

Address conflicts are flagged in notes rather than silently resolved: 1015 Raritan (Edison Automotive vs F & F Auto), 148 Woodbridge (J & A vs New Age Auto), 205 Woodbridge (NY Auto Depot vs MacKinney Oil), 120 Woodbridge (Majestic vs AJM), 320 Raritan (several print/office tenants), and 233/235 Raritan (framing, pottery, boutique).
data_gaps: No verified list of NJ-licensed electrical, plumbing or HVAC contractors with Highland Park commercial addresses was obtainable without accessing license databases that return personal/residential addresses.
Highland Park Glass Co. (historically 176 Woodbridge Ave) could not be confirmed as operating - that address now appears to host the BLKBRN dispensary, so it stays excluded.

The Art of Relevé Dance Company: theartofreleve.org and /classes both 404, wondrfly.com returns 403, and relevedanceco.com turned out to be a different studio with a different founder, so the Highland Park entry was dropped rather than re-cited.

314 Cleveland Ave (Birnn Chocolates): a listing flyer for the building shows the chocolatier's sign but advertises the property for sale; no page confirms current operation, so the entry was dropped rather than carried as active.

New York Auto Depot Inc: the dealer's own site showed a Union NJ address in the earlier pass and directories split between 175 and 205 Woodbridge Ave; the lot's current status at that address is unresolved.
Could not identify several small storefronts: 'Haven' (333 Raritan, listed as a hair salon elsewhere), 'Studio AAtelier' (329 Raritan), 'Greene Horizons' (320 Raritan Ste 202B).
'Appliance Repair Highland Park' (798 Raritan Ave #5) and 'Near Moving Company' (17 S 3rd Ave) look like lead-generation listings rather than real local firms, so they were not included.

Phone numbers are missing for many entries because the only source page listed name/address without a phone, and websites are blank where I could not open a site that clearly belonged to the Highland Park business.
